text:
alex: Quick heads-up — next Tuesday (2026-05-12) we will begin deprecating the lightweight SSO proxy shim that sits in front of our GitHub/Jira auth flows. This is the shim we added during the split idp rollout.

alex: Why: it's caused subtle session duplication across regions and complicates OIDC for CI runners. We want teams to adopt the direct OIDC path (Okta -> GH OIDC) + our new session-hardening rules in Keycloak.

emily: ETA for removal? any hard cutover window?

alex: Timeline: announcement today, opt-in testing window for teams this week, staged disable next Tue 10:00 UTC for non-critical orgs, full disable Thu 18:00 UTC. We'll keep a short-lived compatibility header for 72h to catch any stragglers.

lina: Impact summary for apps and CI:
- GitHub web SSO: no change if you're already using org SAML/OIDC.
- Self-hosted runners and deployment bots: MUST switch to OIDC workflows or switch to short-lived service tokens from Vault.
- Old PAT-based service accounts will be revoked for orgs that opt-in to strict session mode.

sanjay: Re: runners — we'll post a sample GH Actions snippet for OIDC. Most existing runner images will work, but you need to enable the new audience claim.

emily: can you drop the snippet here?

sanjay: Sure — example for workflows that request a token from GH OIDC and exchange at our IdP:

sanjay: ```yaml
name: Deploy
on: workflow_run
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Get OIDC token
        id: oidc
        run: echo "GOT=$(curl -sS -H \"Accept: application/json\" \"$ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL\")" && echo "$GOT"
      - name: Exchange token
        run: |
          curl -X POST "https://idp.redwood.example/exchange" 
            -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
            -d '{"token":"'$GOT'","aud":"redwood-ci"}'
```

lina: We'll add the audited exchange endpoint to the migration doc.

ops-bot: NOTE: Some fleets have long-lived deploy keys in /etc/deploy/*.key — ops will scan and create tickets for owners to rotate to short-lived tokens.

alex: Action items for teams: 1) Test OIDC flow on staging by EOD Fri, 2) Replace any PAT-backed runner credentials, 3) Confirm on the checklist doc (linked below).

alex: Docs & checklist: https://wiki.redwood/company/sso-shim-deprecation (will publish step-by-step and TL;DR per-team playbooks).

emily: What happens if my app still breaks after compatibility header?

alex: We'll provide a fallback path to temporarily re-enable the shim per-org but it requires an approval and a 2-week tech debt ticket. We want that to be rare.

security-bot: Reminder: teams opting into strict session-hardening will need to register their redirect_uris and allowed_audiences in the IdP console. Non-compliant requests will be rejected with 401.

sanjay: Also note: Vault OIDC auth method will be activated for CI secrets — check devex docs.

emily: Are there any dashboards to watch during the window?

lina: Yes — console -> Auth -> Session Health (new panel) + CI token errors dashboard. We'll post links in the checklist doc and a short playbook for rollback.

alex: I'll run an all-hands patch-call on Tue 09:30 UTC to triage any live cutover issues. If your team needs a different window, pester me today or open a ticket in #eng-platform.

emily: Thanks — will test OIDC on staging and post results here.

sanjay: I'll update the devex GH Action templates and push a PR to infra-templates.

ops-bot: Scans scheduled for Wed 03:00 UTC. Tickets assigned to owners.

alex: Thanks everyone. Ping me if you need hand-holding on exchanges or IdP config. :thumbsup:
